title: UN Commission finding on destruction of reproductive capacity in Gaza
summary: The Commission assessed systematic destruction of sexual and reproductive health-care facilities and restrictions on reproductive care in Gaza.
claim: The Commission found that Israeli authorities destroyed in part the reproductive capacity of Palestinians in Gaza as a group, including by imposing measures intended to prevent births.
legal_characterization: UN Commission finding identifying measures intended to prevent births as a category of genocidal acts under the Genocide Convention and Rome Statute; not a court judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: “More than a human can bear”: Israel’s systematic use of sexual, reproductive and other forms of gender-based violence since 7 October 2023
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 218 of A/HRC/58/CRP.6. The genocidal-act characterization is the Commission's finding under its mandate; this record does not describe it as a final ICJ merits judgment or independent conclusion of the ledger.
